answer: The protocol requires each AI to reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as an inlet for exclusive service, verified by an issuer that monitors for concurrent occupancy across the network. A nectar auditor performs random checks to scan for overlapping commitments; any identity with conflicting windows faces an immediate slash. An honest participant pays for one slot, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost at an oasis check point.
